title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 12.10 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 12.10 up to but not including 19.3.9, 19.4 up to but not including 19.4.8, and 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.6 could allow an unauthenticated user to read private project metadata from packages published by other projects due to incorrect authorization checks. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
